name: Governed IDE Catalogue
description: An IDE catalogue with front-door OPA policy and rate limiting pre-added.
details: Seeds the Access Point and Catalogue spine plus the front-door OPA Policy and Rate Limit governance nodes. Select a policy on the OPA node, drag on your LLM Surface members, set a route on the Access Point, then Save.
starter_hint: We've pre-added front-door OPA and rate limiting. Open the OPA Policy node to pick a policy, drag on your LLM Surface members, set a route on the Access Point, then click Save.
